common.source_quote: Heat stress damages chloroplasts and reduces grain yield in rice.
agent.finding_text: Heat stress damages chloroplasts and reduces grain yield in rice.

common.source_quote: How heat signals are transduced from the plasma membrane to chloroplasts remains unknown.
agent.knowledge_gap: How heat signals are transduced from the plasma membrane to chloroplasts remains unknown.

common.source_quote: The objective of this study was to identify genes underlying natural variation in thermotolerance.
agent.experiment_objective: identify genes underlying natural variation in thermotolerance

common.source_quote: A chromosome segment substitution line, SL14, showed higher survival than the recurrent parent WY after 12 h of heat treatment (fig. S1).
agent.actual_observation: SL14, showed higher survival than the recurrent parent WY after 12 h of heat treatment

common.source_quote: We backcrossed SL14 to WY to construct a mapping population.
Using 1,614 BC4F3 plants from this population, qHT3 was narrowed to a 36.6 kb interval on chromosome 3 (Table 1).
Only recombinant plants that survived the heat treatment were advanced to the next generation.
agent.step_condition: Only recombinant plants that survived the heat treatment

common.source_quote: To test whether HTR1 underlies qHT3, we generated knockout lines of HTR1 in WY by CRISPR/Cas9.
To test whether HTR1 underlies qHT3, we generated knockout lines of HTR1 in WY by CRISPR/Cas9.
The knockout lines of HTR1 showed lower survival than WY after heat treatment (fig. S2).
agent.actual_observation: The knockout lines of HTR1 showed lower survival than WY after heat treatment

common.source_quote: We hypothesized that HTR1 might recruit HTR2 precursors to endosomes for degradation.
agent.hypothesis_stated: HTR1 might recruit HTR2 precursors to endosomes for degradation

common.source_quote: HTR1 interacted with HTR2 in a split-luciferase assay (fig. S3).
agent.actual_observation: HTR1 interacted with HTR2 in a split-luciferase assay

common.source_quote: These results indicate that HTR1 acts upstream of HTR2 to protect chloroplasts under heat stress.
agent.finding_text: HTR1 acts upstream of HTR2 to protect chloroplasts under heat stress.

common.source_quote: How HTR2 accumulation damages chloroplasts remains to be determined.
agent.knowledge_gap: How HTR2 accumulation damages chloroplasts remains to be determined.

common.source_quote: Twelve-day-old seedlings were treated at 42 C for 14 h and survival was scored after 7 days of recovery.
Each line was tested in 3 biological replicates of 24 plants.
Survival rates were compared with a two-tailed t test.
Split-luciferase assays were performed in Nicotiana benthamiana leaves.
